decision: Selected the Ryhti reference point of permanent building 102955298M, the former Summa paper-mill building at Ensontie 1 that building permit 300146206N (decided October 2009; expansion of 24,478 m2 and alteration comparable to rebuilding of 15,657 m2, works recorded from 22 January 2010 and completed 16 May and 28 June 2011) converted into Google's first Hamina data centre, as the campus locator for the Google Hamina data-centre campus on properties 075-406-57-7 and 075-406-57-8. It locates that building's register point; it is not a footprint, a property boundary, an entrance or a claim about any individual hall.

selected_properties.completion_date: 2011-06-28 (expansion record, 24,478 m2); 2011-05-16 (alteration comparable to rebuilding, 15,657 m2)
selected_properties.construction_action_type: code 02 (expansion) and code 03 (alteration work comparable to rebuilding)
selected_properties.main_purpose: code 02 (office, production, utility and other buildings)
selected_properties.address: Ensontie 1, 49420 Hamina (Ryhti open_permit_address record linked by building_key; local_data/country-research-google-ops-intl-p15/ryhti-address-ensontie-hamina.json)

check: The native EPSG:3067 position was recomputed from Ryhti's WGS84 output with pyproj 3.7.1 (uv run --no-project --with pyproj==3.7.1). Distances are haversine distances from the selected point.
excluded_sources: No geocoder, commercial map, map viewport or embed, PeeringDB, OpenStreetMap service, city centre or headquarters address is used. Google's locations index gives no coordinates for Hamina (latitude and longitude null).
